comment: Answer key for the root-cause fixture. The symptom (a failing quote test) sits three modules away from the cause (to_cents truncates instead of rounding half up), the commit that made it visible is a TEST-DATA change, and the most suspicious-looking recent commit — a zone-lookup cache — is innocent. Two more sites carry the same truncation with no test at all. Scored on state.json like every other eval; a run that names the cache or the test change as the cause has told a plausible story instead of finding the defect.

terms_any: the cache is the root cause
root cause is the test change
